context.purpose: Trim, reorder and repeat explicit video source ranges as an editable Shotcut timeline and a verified silent FFV1 video.
context.assumptions: Integer constant fps, matching source/timeline pixel dimensions and square progressive frames; Shotcut-bundled melt with matching ffmpeg and ffprobe beside it. Named source files are captured before rendering.
context.constraints: One contiguous video track, no gaps/transitions/audio/subtitles/rotation/resizing. At most 16 assets, 128 cuts, 600 frames and 192 MiB of retained/decoded source RGB. Each source must begin at timestamp zero. MLT colour conversion has fixed pixel error bounds.
context.inspection: Read back native reloaded MLT profile, asset identities and ordered inclusive ranges; compare every rendered frame with the source-frame selection and require identical original/reloaded render RGB. Inspect verification.json, stages and actual video.
context.recovery: INVALID_SELECTION means an unknown asset name. INVALID_RANGE means a selected range exceeds retained source frames. INVALID_MEDIA needs matching fps/dimensions, silent progressive square pixels and zero-based constant timestamps. INTERPRETER_NOT_FOUND requires Shotcut bundled tools. Preserve failed logs and retry in a fresh directory.

Native probe/decode stage input hashes bind retained readback to the actual consumed publication bytes; ordinary artifact hash refresh cannot reuse prior readback.
